title: Influencer Marketing Trainee
jobDescription: Digital Web Solutions, through its brand Collab X, is seeking 25 enthusiastic individuals to join our Influencer Marketing Trainee program. This 6-month paid training initiative is designed for freshers with no prior experience, offering hands-on, on-the-job training from day one. You will be immersed in real client work, learning the intricacies of influencer marketing in a fast-growing industry. Upon successful completion of the training and a performance check, you will receive a full-time job offer with a competitive salary package. This program is ideal for graduates or undergraduates looking to kickstart their career in a dynamic field while potentially continuing their education. • Identify and reach out to relevant influencers for Collab X's clients • Coordinate collaborations and manage campaign timelines • Work with influencers to create promotional videos for client brands • Track campaign performance and report results • Participate in hands-on, on-the-job training for 6 months • Engage in real client work from day one • Learn the fundamentals of influencer marketing • Contribute to campaign strategy and execution • Analyze campaign data and provide insights • Collaborate with internal teams to ensure campaign success

title: IT & Network Administrator
jobDescription: Digital Web Solutions is seeking a dedicated and hands-on IT & Network Administrator to manage our office's entire IT and network infrastructure. This is a critical role where you will be the primary point of contact for all technology-related matters, ensuring seamless operations and providing essential support to our team. You will be responsible for the end-to-end management of our internet connectivity, local area network (LAN), and Wi-Fi performance. This includes proactive monitoring, troubleshooting, and optimization to guarantee reliable and efficient network services for all employees. Beyond network infrastructure, you will handle a wide range of IT support tasks, including hardware setup and maintenance, software installation and configuration, and managing IT assets. Your ability to diagnose and resolve technical issues promptly will be key to minimizing downtime and maintaining productivity. This role also requires strong communication skills, as you will interact directly with employees at all levels to understand their IT needs, provide guidance, and resolve issues. You will also be responsible for coordinating with external vendors for services and equipment, ensuring we receive the best support and value. • Oversee and manage the office's internet, Wi-Fi, and LAN infrastructure. • Ensure optimal performance, reliability, and security of the network. • Troubleshoot and resolve network connectivity and performance issues. • Manage and maintain all office IT hardware, including computers, printers, and servers. • Install, configure, and update software applications for employees. • Provide technical support and assistance to employees for IT-related issues. • Conduct regular system checks and maintenance to prevent potential problems. • Manage IT assets and inventory. • Coordinate with IT vendors for procurement, support, and service delivery. • Communicate effectively with employees and leadership regarding IT matters and solutions. • Develop and implement IT policies and procedures as needed. • Stay updated on the latest IT trends and technologies.

title: Senior PPC Executive
jobDescription: Digital Web Solutions is seeking a highly skilled and experienced Performance Marketing Specialist to join our dynamic team. This role is perfect for a data-driven individual with a proven track record of managing and optimizing PPC and Paid Social campaigns. You will be instrumental in driving client success through strategic campaign planning, execution, and analysis. As a Performance Marketing Specialist, you will take ownership of client accounts, identifying key growth opportunities and leveraging your expertise in Google Ads and Meta Ads to achieve client objectives. Your ability to analyze complex performance data, troubleshoot technical issues, and communicate clear, actionable recommendations will be crucial. This position requires a proactive approach to campaign management, a deep understanding of marketing technology, and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams. If you are passionate about performance marketing and eager to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply. This is a full-time, on-site opportunity located in Noida, offering a 5.5-day work week with fixed off days on the 1st and 3rd Saturdays and Sundays. • Plan, launch, and optimize Google Ads campaigns across Search, Display, Remarketing, Performance Max, and You Tube. • Create and manage Meta Ads campaigns focused on lead generation, e Commerce, and brand awareness. • Conduct comprehensive keyword research, audience research, competitor analysis, and strategic campaign planning. • Continuously optimize bids, audiences, ad creatives, landing pages, and budgets to maximize campaign performance and ROI. • Set up and manage conversion tracking, Google Tag Manager (GTM), and Google Analytics 4 (GA4) implementations. • Monitor campaign performance daily, proactively troubleshoot tracking issues, and ensure accurate attribution modeling. • Develop performance dashboards and prepare insightful client-facing reports with actionable optimization strategies. • Analyze key performance metrics including ROAS, CPA, CPL, CTR, Conversion Rate, and Revenue to drive strategic decisions. • Conduct in-depth competitor research using tools such as Spy Fu, Ahrefs, SEMrush, and Google Keyword Planner. • Present campaign performance, optimization strategies, and strategic recommendations to clients during regular meetings. • Manage multiple client accounts simultaneously, ensuring seamless collaboration with developers, designers, content teams, and account managers.

title: Quality Executive
jobDescription: Digital Web Solutions is seeking a meticulous and detail-oriented Quality Assurance Auditor to join our dynamic team. In this role, you will be instrumental in upholding our commitment to excellence by conducting thorough quality checks and internal operational audits. Your primary focus will be to identify process gaps, errors, and opportunities for enhancement, ensuring that our operations consistently meet the highest quality standards and client expectations. This position requires a proactive individual who can analyze workflows, document findings, and collaborate with various teams to implement corrective actions. You will play a key part in maintaining the integrity of our services and contributing to continuous improvement initiatives. If you have a keen eye for detail, a strong understanding of quality management principles, and a passion for driving operational efficiency, we encourage you to apply. Join us at Digital Web Solutions and help shape the future of our quality assurance processes. • Conduct regular quality checks and internal operational audits to assess performance and compliance. • Identify process gaps, errors, and areas for improvement across various operational functions. • Ensure team compliance with established quality standards and specific client guidelines. • Track key quality metrics and prepare insightful audit reports for management review. • Document audit findings, including non-compliance issues and recommendations. • Collaborate with operational teams to develop and implement corrective action plans. • Monitor the effectiveness of implemented improvements. • Stay updated on industry best practices and quality assurance methodologies. • Contribute to the development and refinement of quality assurance procedures. • Maintain accurate records of all audit activities and findings.

title: Senior Digital Recruiter/ Team Lead
jobDescription: Digital Web Solutions is seeking an experienced Senior Digital Recruiter or Team Leader to join our dynamic HR team. The ideal candidate will possess a strong background in digital recruitment, with a proven track record of successfully sourcing and hiring specialized talent within the digital marketing space. This role requires a strategic thinker capable of building robust talent pipelines, managing recruitment processes efficiently, and leading a team of recruiters. As a Senior Digital Recruiter and Team Lead, you will be instrumental in driving our talent acquisition strategy for both niche digital roles and essential support functions. You will collaborate closely with hiring managers and stakeholders to understand their needs and deliver high-quality candidates within agreed-upon timelines. Your expertise in digital marketing profiles, including SEO, PPC, SEM, outreach, guest posting, link building, and off-page SEO, will be crucial for success. This is a full-time, in-office position within a 5.5-day working week. We offer a collaborative environment where your contributions will directly impact the growth and success of Digital Web Solutions. If you are a results-oriented recruiter with leadership potential and a passion for digital talent, we encourage you to apply. • Lead and manage a team of recruiters, providing guidance and mentorship. • Develop and implement effective recruitment strategies for digital marketing roles (SEO, PPC, SEM, outreach, guest posting, link building, off-page SEO). • Build and maintain a strong pipeline of qualified candidates for current and future hiring needs. • Manage the full recruitment lifecycle, from sourcing and screening to offer negotiation and onboarding. • Ensure timely closure of open positions, meeting or exceeding target time-to-hire. • Collaborate with hiring managers and stakeholders to define job requirements and candidate profiles. • Source candidates through various channels, including job boards, social media, professional networks, and direct outreach. • Conduct thorough candidate assessments, including interviews and skill evaluations. • Extend and negotiate job offers. • Support hiring for various business functions including sales, marketing, accounts, and business development. • Track recruitment metrics and provide regular reports to management. • Stay updated on industry trends and best practices in digital recruitment. • First and Third Saturday will be fixed off. Other Saturdays are working
